Container.Name: Mars Control Plane
Container.Overview: Mars control plane. Requires an external PostgreSQL 17 database and an HTTPS reverse proxy with WebSocket support. Worker execution runtimes are external to Unraid.

Config.Name: Persistent data
Config.Description: Persistent control-plane data, including app_master_key. Back up this directory together with PostgreSQL; losing either makes encrypted credentials unrecoverable.

Config.Name: Public base URL
Config.Description: Canonical browser origin for OAuth and setup callbacks. HTTP localhost is valid for local access; use HTTPS for remote browser access. This is not the GitHub webhook origin.

Config.Name: GitHub webhook URL
Config.Description: Required public HTTPS origin root GitHub can reach. Mars appends /api/github/webhooks; do not include a path or use localhost/private hosts.

Config.Name: Worker base URL
Config.Description: Optional single HTTPS origin workers use to connect. Defaults to the public base URL when empty; do not use this as the GitHub/browser or webhook origin.

Config.Name: Worker release manifest URL
Config.Description: HTTPS URL for the worker release manifest. The control plane accepts only a compatible contract version and requires linux-x64 metadata.

Config.Name: Worker contract version
Config.Description: Control-plane worker contract version. Worker releases must use the same major and a minor version no higher than this value.
